messages:
maria: Heads-up: Customer NimbusAI flagged INV-2026-0618 — two reserved commit lines for same nodepool and hour (np-eu-1). Can someone check if this is legit or double-billed?
devin: share the invoice lines please.
maria: pasted snippet:
```
line_id,nodepool,region,hour_start,hour_end,gpu_hours,rate
L-10021,np-eu-1,eu-central-1,2026-06-17T09:00Z,2026-06-17T10:00Z,10.0,2.10
L-10022,np-eu-1 (failover),eu-central-1,2026-06-17T09:00Z,2026-06-17T10:00Z,10.0,2.10
```
accounting-bot: Metering export attached: s3://exports/nimbus/2026-06/meter-0617.csv sha256: f7e3b.
lucas: infra note  there was a scaled maintenance at 09:12 where standby was promoted. Metering rounds to hour buckets so both primary+failover show for same bucket. overlap ~48 minutes.
devin: calc: dup = 10 gpu-hours * $2.10 = $21.00 extra. Invoice currently charged $42.00 for that hour.
maria: policy check  do we auto-credit overlaps under $50?
accounting-bot: Policy: duplicates under $100 may be credited without escalation.
devin: propose apply provisional credit CR-2026-334 for $21.00, notify customer, open vendor recovery VND-4618. Approve?
lucas: approve and I'll add a quick dedupe in metering to collapse identical nodepool+hour rows when only suffix differs.
maria: approved. I'll send the customer note: "We've applied a $21 credit due to duplicated metering during failover; we're investigating with our partner".
accounting-bot: CR-2026-334 created and applied to INV-2026-0618. FIN ticket FIN-2026-402 opened to track recovery.
vendor-bot: Vendor claim VND-4618 created and assigned to partner ops. Requesting host logs.
maria: customer acknowledged and appreciated the quick turnaround. Closing thread after vendor response. :white_check_mark:
